title: A lane or coordinator that takes or agrees to a departing pick cites the past rulings it checked
why: The coordinator agreed at 07:59 CST Nov 8 to lane guard-relative-write-escape's pick (refuse a top-level `git -C` write into an agent worktree). Neither searched docs/decisions, and the pick contradicted owner rulings in decision agent-worktree-discard-is-noted. Review round 1 caught it (coordinator 08:24 CST; lane [ended:lane-guard-relative-write-escape] 08:23 CST). The past-ruling check (step question-checks-past-rulings, done) runs only on questions to the owner.
note: Merges the coordinator's pick-ack-past-ruling and the lane's pick-checks-owner-rulings, one incident. Scope: a pick a lane takes that departs from main, and a coordinator message that agrees to one, names the decisions it checked; the check asks when none is named. Candidate homes: the brief template and hooks/agent_brief.py, or the past-ruling search that question-checks-past-rulings built; the lane picks one and calls it, no copy. Done check: a red test where an agreement to a departing pick with no decisions named is asked. Build lane. Filed by triage 08:25 CST Nov 8. Started by the coordinator 08:27 CST Nov 8 in lane [ended:lane:-pick-ack-past-ruling]. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was [ended:lane:-pick-ack-past-ruling]). Plan R51 "A pick reads its ruling before it is sent" (owner approved 12:35 CST Nov 12; home decision session-tiers; restart-plan a2b2c8b). Owner 12:33 CST: "it's weird that ure making half-baked calls". Top of now: before the send, the check makes a coordinator pick cite a ruling or write "no ruling found: <search>". Joins the work of step past-ruling-on-send. Lane started by the coordinator 12:38 CST. Lane 14:27 CST Nov 12 (#2932, head 3c38ce6db): owner item 644 asks whether briefs and SendMessage are judged too. Unmeasured, not asked: whether a coordinator calls get_session again after it self-tags; the check handles both orders. Merge note: #2932 and #2740 both edit the settings.json matcher line; re-point the matcher test at merge and make PICK_SEND_TOOL SEND_TOOLS[0].
